English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fake Photo of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake Carrying a Tea Plucking Basket is Digitally Altered False A viral photo of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake carrying a tea plucking basket in Nuwara Eliya is an AI-manipulated fake. by Anonymous | February 12, 2026 A photograph purportedly showing President Anura Kumara Dissanayake carrying a tea-plucking basket during his recent visit to Nuwara Eliya (on the 11th) has been circulating widely on social media. The image has sparked various reactions on Facebook, ranging from sharp political criticism to satirical commentary. However, upon investigation, FactSeeker has confirmed that this image is digitally altered (manipulated). The Fact On Wednesday afternoon (the 11th), President Anura Kumara Dissanayake visited Nuwara Eliya to participate in the Central Province program of the “A Whole Nation as One” national initiative aimed at eradicating the drug menace. During this visit, the President met with plantation workers in the district to discuss their well-being and engage in friendly conversation. An authentic photograph taken during this interaction was manipulated using AI technology to make it appear as though the President was wearing a tea-plucking basket. Evidence Official Sources: The President’s Media Division (PMD) released the original photos from the event, which show the President talking to workers without the basket. Photo Link : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jG3P1_0q_ZAkP1o1qo1RlTM0rqjzTr9Y?usp=sharing Media Coverage: Several mainstream media outlets covered the event and shared authentic visuals that contradict the viral post. Video Proof: You can view the official video of the President’s visit to Nuwara Eliya shared by the PMD here: Video Link: :- https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zv26u277ZSRwpKZ2ETEO2wGIF1ZbVfrm/view?usp=sharing Conclusion FactSeeker confirms that the image of the President carrying a tea plucking basket is morphed.
